description: Submit a WebAuthn passkey signature for an envelope. The Worker verifies the assertion against the signer's DID-registered credential, recomputes the challenge hash, and writes an `com.etzhayyim.esign.signature` record. When the envelope's signer set is fully closed, the Worker also emits a `completedEvent` in the same call.

completedEventUri.description: Present iff this signature closed the envelope.

errors.name: NotASigner
errors.description: signerDid is not in the envelope's signers array.

errors.name: OutOfOrder
errors.description: Envelope.signingOrder is sequential and signerDid is not the next expected signer.

errors.name: WebauthnVerifyFailed
errors.description: Assertion did not verify against the signer's DID-registered credential.

errors.name: ChallengeMismatch
errors.description: clientDataJSON challenge does not equal sha256(envelopeUri || signerDid || nonce).

errors.name: EnvelopeNotOpen
errors.description: Envelope status is not `requested` / `partially_signed` (already completed / declined / expired).

errors.name: DocumentHashMismatch
errors.description: The signer's assertion references a documentSha256 different from envelope.documentSha256.
